:::{#exm-moore-penrose-gram-cor}
#### Recovering the Moore-Penrose inverse of a column of ones

For $\matr{A} = \begin{bmatrix} 1 \\ 1 \end{bmatrix}$, @exm-moore-penrose-gram found $(\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A})^+ = \begin{bmatrix} 1/2 \end{bmatrix}$.
Then

$$
\ba
(\tp{\matr{A}}\matr{A})^+\,\tp{\matr{A}}
&= \begin{bmatrix} 1/2 \end{bmatrix}\begin{bmatrix} 1 & 1 \end{bmatrix}
\\
&= \begin{bmatrix} 1/2 & 1/2 \end{bmatrix},
\ea
$$

which is $\matr{A}^+$, as @cor-moore-penrose-gram states.

:::
